methods.title: Dotted Rhythmic Pairs
methods.summary: Reverse long-short and short-long rhythms within four note pairs.
instructionSentences: Practice each pair as a dotted eighth note followed by a sixteenth note.
Then reverse every pair while keeping each pair within one steady beat.

methods.title: Four Fast Notes and Four Slow Notes
methods.summary: Alternate groups of four sixteenth notes and four eighth notes.
instructionSentences: Keep a steady pulse when changing between fast and slow notes.
Play the fast group evenly and without tension.
methods.directionAboveExercise: Keep a steady pulse when changing between fast and slow notes. Play the fast group evenly and without tension.

methods.title: Two Fast Notes and Two Slow Notes
methods.summary: Alternate two-note fast and slow groups, then reverse them.
instructionSentences: Play two fast notes and then two slow notes while keeping a steady pulse.
Reverse the pattern in the second measure and change speeds smoothly.
methods.directionAboveExercise: Change smoothly between the fast and slow pairs without interrupting the pulse.

methods.title: One Long Note and Three Short Notes
methods.summary: Place the long note first and then last in each four-note group.
instructionSentences: Keep the three short notes even.
Use the long note to prepare the next movement without tightening the hand.
methods.directionAboveExercise: Keep the three short notes even. Use the long note to prepare the next movement without tightening the hand.

methods.title: Moving the Long Note Within the Group
methods.summary: Move the long note through the two inner positions of each four-note group.
instructionSentences: Maintain the pulse as the long note changes position.
Do not add an accent simply because a note is longer.
methods.directionAboveExercise: Maintain the pulse as the long note changes position. Do not add an accent simply because a note is longer.

methods.title: Long Notes Outside and Inside the Group
methods.summary: Contrast longer notes at the edges with longer notes in the middle.
instructionSentences: Play the longer notes at the edges of each group in the first measure.
Move the longer notes to the middle in the second measure without changing the pulse.
